purpose: Genome-BAM strandedness inference shared by FASTQ and BAM entry, for samples explicitly requesting auto

gffread.option_semantics: Output transcript records as BED rather than GFF3, verified in pinned source; retain first 12 columns and validate coordinate/strand/block-count basics.

adaptations: Keep classic versions.yml emission for the existing pipeline version collector; do not adopt new topic/eval outputs.
Stage sorted genome BAM and BAI as one tuple; the native tool itself streams BAM records without index access.
Explicit sample_size and mapq arguments replace the open-ended upstream task.ext.args interface.
Capture native stdout as txt and stderr as log, including the native usable-read count.
Use fully qualified Quay image identifiers and recognize both Singularity and Apptainer.
Produce BED12 with the existing gffread0.12.1 container; no UCSC download or independent annotation resource.
Empty stub files do not invent measured strand fractions.
Request one CPU via process_single for the sequential native alignment stream; tool arguments and sampling defaults are unchanged.

native_contract.sampling: First eligible gene-overlapping alignment records in BAM stream order; not random subsampling and not paired fragment counts.
native_contract.usable_read_count_stderr_pattern: Total N usable reads were sampled
native_contract.invalid_layout: Mixture/Unknown Data type or a native layout that disagrees with declared single_end must fail in the caller.
native_contract.native_filtering: QC-failed, duplicate, secondary, unmapped and mapq-below-cutoff records are skipped; source does not explicitly skip supplementary records.

classification_reference.unresolved_policy: Caller fails unresolved auto inference; no silent unstranded fallback.
